Protobuf dump helpers for transactions, blocks, syscalls, and ELF loader context.

# Purpose
This C file builds protobuf dump records for Solana execution state. It collects data from transactions, instructions, blocks, VM syscalls, and ELF program loads, then encodes that data with nanopb and writes it to files in the capture output directory. The main purpose is to export execution context in a form that test tools and replay tools can read. It uses `fd_spad_t` scratch memory for temporary storage and filters output by transaction signature when a filter is set in `fd_capture_ctx_t`.

The file defines helper code to gather and deduplicate account data, include related programdata accounts, include address lookup table accounts, and copy bank state such as sysvars, builtins, vote accounts, stake accounts, blockhash queues, features, inflation, and slot data. It also creates synthetic vote account records from vote state cache entries. The public APIs [`fd_dump_instr_to_protobuf`](<#fd_dump_instr_to_protobuf>), [`fd_dump_txn_to_protobuf`](<#fd_dump_txn_to_protobuf>), [`fd_dump_block_to_protobuf_collect_tx`](<#fd_dump_block_to_protobuf_collect_tx>), [`fd_dump_block_to_protobuf`](<#fd_dump_block_to_protobuf>), [`fd_dump_vm_syscall_to_protobuf`](<#fd_dump_vm_syscall_to_protobuf>), and [`fd_dump_elf_to_protobuf`](<#fd_dump_elf_to_protobuf>) are the external entry points that produce the protobuf files for each capture type.
